text:
Alex Kim: Quick follow-up from the outage earlier today — we should lock a PIR within the next 5 business days. Incident summary: session-db OOM caused spike in 503s, two paying customers saw partial session loss. Sam is incident owner. Looking for a facilitator and folks who must be in the room (billing, infra, serving runtime).

incident-bot: Incident #INC-20260312 closed at 2026-03-12T18:24:12Z. Post-incident review template: https://rwinf.internal/pir-templates/session-db-oom

Maria Chen: I'm available mornings PT most days. Can facilitate if nobody else volunteers, but would prefer someone not on the hot path (so infra/ops can be deep in the convo). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam Ortiz: thanks @Maria. I can present timeline and customer impact. Would prefer the facilitator to run the readout + action tracking.

Jess Rivera: Heads up — product + billing need to be there for customer comms/comp. I can do EU-friendly times after 16:00 UTC.

Tyler Nguyen: I can take facilitator if that helps; haven't been paged into this oncall today so low context-switch. Prefer Thu 15:00 UTC or Fri 09:00 PT.

Alex Kim: Proposed slots (trying to cover APAC -> EU -> NA):
- Option A: Thu 2026-03-18 01:00 UTC (APAC-friendly)
- Option B: Thu 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC (EU/NA overlap)
- Option C: Fri 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC (late EU / early NA)

Maria Chen: Option B works for me. Option A is rough for PST folks.

Sam Ortiz: Option B is best. Can do C as fallback.

incident-bot: Reminder: please attach the incident log bundle to the PIR doc before the meeting. Command: `incident export INC-20260312 > /tmp/INC-20260312.zip`

Jess Rivera: If we pick Option B, I'll invite billing and CS leads and ask customer-facing to prepare short impact notes. Can we invite one customer rep to join for 10 minutes?

Tyler Nguyen: I can facilitate if others are okay. I'll run the agenda, keep to 60m, and capture action items. Volunteer accepted unless someone objects.

Alex Kim: Sounds good. Tyler, can you own pre-read and facilitator checklist? Also capture rollout/rollback decision history.

Tyler Nguyen: Yep. I'll drop pre-read by EOD tomorrow and add a short timeline + logs pointer.

Maria Chen: I'll add a quick model of expected affected sessions (estimation) to the pre-read — helps scope remediation.

Sam Ortiz: I'll prepare the timeline + pager traces.

Jess Rivera: I'll coordinate invites and confirm whether a customer rep wants to sit in for the first 10 minutes.

Alex Kim: Draft agenda (Tyler feel free to edit):
```
- 5m: Purpose + scope (Tyler)
- 15m: Timeline & what happened (Sam)
- 10m: Customer impact summary (Jess)
- 15m: Root cause analysis & contributing factors (Maria + infra)
- 10m: Action items, owners, timelines (all)
- 5m: Communications & follow-ups (Jess)
```

Tyler Nguyen: Agenda acked. I'll assign owners in the doc. Suggest we tag any high-cost fixes as blockers and route to eng-sre.

Maria Chen: One ask — can we capture the specific query that triggered the large KV write? I put a note in the logs pointer.

Sam Ortiz: noted. Also pinging infra to attach memory profiling. @infra-team please attach heap dumps if available.

raj-infra-bot: Notified infra on-call: @infra-oncall. Heap dump retrieval may take ~30m.

Alex Kim: OK locking Option B: Thu 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. Tyler is facilitator. Meeting length 60m, invite to go out from Jess.

Jess Rivera: Invite sent to: engineering, infra, product, billing, cs leads, and incident owner. Calendar event includes pre-read link and timeline. :white_check_mark:

Tyler Nguyen: Pre-read link: https://rwinf.internal/pir/session-db-oom/pre-read (will populate by EOD tomorrow). Action items starter list in doc.

Alex Kim: Quick action items to capture now (Tyler will formalize):
- A1: Add heap dumps + profiler output -> owner: raj-infra, due: 2026-03-14
- A2: Customer impact summary + compensation recommendation -> owner: Jess, due: 2026-03-15
- A3: Short-term mitigation (tweak session expiry + autoscale) -> owner: Maria, due: 2026-03-13
- A4: Postmortem write-up draft -> owner: Tyler, due: 2026-03-19

Tyler Nguyen: Will populate those as separate items in action tracker and add severity/cost estimates.

Sam Ortiz: One more — ensure we record decisions about rollback vs patch in notes (so we can tie to release cadence).

Jess Rivera: Customer rep confirmed for first 10 minutes. I'll have CS prepare verbatim impact statements.

incident-bot: Meeting scheduled for 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. Attachments required: logs bundle, heap dumps, pre-read.

Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping this thread. We'll run a 5-minute rehearsal with facilitator 30m before the meeting if Tyler wants.

Tyler Nguyen: I'll do the 30m pre-check. See you all in the PIR. :calendar:
